text:
elaine (PM): Quick decision needed on visibility-lite scope. AcmeHealth needs per-route cost + CSV export for audits. Options: cost-first v1 or tracing-first v1.

devon (eng): Cost-first is much cheaper infra-wise: compute attribution from routing metadata, add sampled traces later.

raj (eng-sre): Agree. Hard constraints: dataplane CPU overhead <5% p95, bounded trace retention. Require exporter circuit-breaker for backpressure.

maria (design): UX: surface a 'route insights' card (hourly cost, p50/p95, error-rate, 1 sampled trace). That answers most user questions.

sophie (cs): AcmeHealth will accept sampled traces if CSV export is exact. I'll request a pilot for CSV schema.

josh (sales): Multiple enterprise deals depend on audit exports. This is a gating requirement for Dedicated customers.

deploy-bot: canary created: visibility-lite-canary-2026-03 (targets: acme-pilot, beta-corp, internal).

elaine (PM): Draft acceptance for cost-first v1: per-route hourly cost, route insights card, CSV export, 1% sampled traces for top-10 routes, circuit-breaker, canary to 3 pilots, docs + quickstart.

devon (eng): :thumbsup: can deliver in 6 sprints if limited to hourly agg + top-10 routes.

raj (eng-sre): :thinking: add explicit SLOs for trace retention and fail-open behavior on exporter failure.

maria (design): :thumbsup: mockups by Thu EOD.

sophie (cs): will confirm pilot window with AcmeHealth by Fri.

josh (sales): will attach pilot agreement.

elaine (PM): Actions locked: devon tech-spec Tue, raj cb+runbook Wed, maria mockups Thu, sophie/josh pilot Fri. Locking scope if no objections by EOD.

devon (eng): no objections.

raj (eng-sre): ok if circuit-breaker mandatory.

maria (design): ok.

sophie (cs): ok.

josh (sales): ok.

elaine (PM): Scope locked. Creating PRD now.
